e.title: Insurance Europe（欧洲保险联盟）
e.summary: 欧洲保险业联合会：Solvency II/气候/数字与 AI/消费者保护议题文件 + 统计 + GFIA 秘书处
e.summary_en: European insurance federation: position papers on Solvency II, climate, digital & AI and consumer protection, plus statistics and the GFIA secretariat
e.summary_hk: 歐洲保險業聯合會：Solvency II/氣候/數字與 AI/消費者保護議題文件 + 統計 + GFIA 秘書處
e.body: Insurance Europe（`insuranceeurope.eu`）是**欧洲保险与再保险业的联合会**（成员为各国保险协会），其网站是追踪欧洲保险监管议题的高效入口。栏目按议题组织，可核实的重点包括：**Regulation & competitiveness**（Solvency II、跨境监管与国际审慎动态、恢复与处置 recovery & resolution、税务、简化）、**Climate, sustainability & resilience**（气候变化、自然灾害巨灾风险、Sustainability Hub）、**Digital, AI & cyber**（网络、数据保护、数字化）、**Serving & protecting consumers**（Consumer Hub、消费者保护监管、分销、金融教育 #InsureWisely、PRIIPs 与零售投资策略 RIS 包）、**Insurance, people & society**（反欺诈、健康保险、责任险、车险、风险导向核保、DEI）、以及 **Statistics** 与 **Publications** 板块。此外它是 **GFIA（全球保险协会联合会）的秘书处**，也是 **FinDatEx** 成员，并设有**再保险顾问委员会（RAB）**。对 RIAA：这是「**欧洲监管议题 → 行业立场 → 支撑数据**」的完整链条样本——想知道 Solvency II 修订、巨灾保障缺口、AI 在保险中的监管态度如何演化，这里能一次拿到行业侧的正式回应；与 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]（EIOPA 官方统计与数据）、[[solvency2rfr]]（无风险利率期限结构）构成「监管机构 vs 行业组织」的一对；消费者保护与反欺诈议题可与 [[hk-icb]]、[[insurance-governance]] 对照；适合作监管比较、偿付能力与欧洲市场方向。
e.body_en: Insurance Europe (`insuranceeurope.eu`) is **the federation of the European insurance and reinsurance industry** (its members are national insurance associations), and its site is an efficient entry point for tracking European insurance regulation. Content is organised by topic; verifiable highlights include **Regulation & competitiveness** (Solvency II, international prudential developments, recovery & resolution, taxation, simplification), **Climate, sustainability & resilience** (climate change, natural catastrophes, Sustainability Hub), **Digital, AI & cyber** (cyber, data protection, digitalisation), **Serving & protecting consumers** (Consumer Hub, consumer-protection regulation, distribution, financial education #InsureWisely, PRIIPs and the Retail Investment Strategy package), **Insurance, people & society** (fraud prevention, health insurance, liability, motor insurance, risk-based underwriting, DEI), plus **Statistics** and **Publications** sections. It also serves as the **secretariat of GFIA** (the Global Federation of Insurance Associations), is a **FinDatEx** member, and hosts the **Reinsurance Advisory Board (RAB)**. For RIAA: a complete sample of the chain "**European regulatory agenda → industry position → supporting data**" — to see how Solvency II revision, the catastrophe protection gap or regulatory attitudes to AI in insurance are evolving, this is where the industry’s formal responses are collected; together with [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] (EIOPA’s official statistics and data) and [[solvency2rfr]] (risk-free rate term structures) it forms a "supervisor vs industry body" pair; consumer-protection and fraud topics can be read against [[hk-icb]] and [[insurance-governance]]; suits regulatory comparison, solvency and European-market work.
e.body_hk: Insurance Europe（`insuranceeurope.eu`）是**歐洲保險與再保險業的聯合會**（成員為各國保險協會），其網站是追蹤歐洲保險監管議題的高效入口。欄目按議題組織，可核實的重點包括：**Regulation & competitiveness**（Solvency II、國際審慎動態、恢復與處置、稅務、簡化）、**Climate, sustainability & resilience**（氣候變化、自然災害巨災風險、Sustainability Hub）、**Digital, AI & cyber**（網絡、數據保護、數字化）、**Serving & protecting consumers**（Consumer Hub、消費者保護監管、分銷、金融教育 #InsureWisely、PRIIPs 與 RIS 包）、**Insurance, people & society**（反欺詐、健康保險、責任險、車險、風險導向核保、DEI）、以及 **Statistics** 與 **Publications** 板塊。此外它是 **GFIA 的秘書處**，也是 **FinDatEx** 成員，並設有**再保險顧問委員會（RAB）**。對 RIAA：這是「**歐洲監管議題 → 行業立場 → 支撐數據**」的完整鏈條樣本；與 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[solvency2rfr]] 構成「監管機構 vs 行業組織」的一對；消費者保護與反欺詐議題可與 [[hk-icb]]、[[insurance-governance]] 對照；適合作監管比較、償付能力與歐洲市場方向。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测 + 首页内容核实（Regulation & competitiveness / Climate, sustainability & resilience / Digital, AI & cyber / Serving & protecting consumers / Insurance, people & society 五大议题 + Statistics 与 Publications；GFIA 秘书处、FinDatEx 成员、RAB 再保险顾问委员会）
